name: open_dos_library_or_fail
description: Tries to open the dos library and returns its handle when that succeeds. Otherwise it runs a second library call, stores 100 as its result and returns it after cleanup.

name: start_resident_tool_process
description: Starts a named tool by finding its resident tag and creating a process for it, with a debug option. On failure it reports that the resident tag or tool could not be found or started, and it waits on a message port for the tool to answer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:LoadWB:2:0110
name: compare_null_terminated_strings

name: build_allocated_node_list
description: Walks a chain of records, allocating a node for each with the system memory allocator, storing a duplicated lock in it and linking the nodes together. It returns the first node.

name: pass_params_to_subroutine

name: format_buffer_and_forward_length
description: Formats text into a 140-byte stack buffer through a library formatting routine, then measures its length by counting up to the null terminator. If the length is nonzero it passes the buffer and length to another routine.

name: store_byte_at_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of the data register to the memory address held in a pointer register and returns. Its address is referenced by one routine, so it is used as a small callback.

name: run_boot_block_entry
description: Boot block entry point, called by the boot strap. It sets a status flag, then either jumps into a routine held in a loaded buffer or calls a library routine and returns zero on success and minus one otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:bootblock:0:00A0
name: open_dos_library_at_boot
description: Boot-time routine that clears a flag, calls two routines, then tries to open the dos library through the library base. It returns minus one on failure and, on success, decrements a counter and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:bootblock:0:00EA
name: hook_trackdisk_device_handler
description: Boot-time routine that installs its own handler in the trackdisk device and interrupt entries, keeping the originals, then returns. If the device cannot be found it falls back to a library open call and returns minus one on failure.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:bootblock:0:015C
name: fill_stub_structure_and_register
description: Fills a small block in memory with pointer and flag values, including a short code stub that points at a second routine. It passes the block to a library routine and stores the returned value in a context field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:bootblock:0:01B8
name: checksum_block_on_status_interrupt
description: Interrupt-style handler that, when the device is ready and a status bit is set, copies a block of bytes, sums it with carry into a checksum and updates a stored value and two counters. It then passes control to the previously saved handler.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:bootblock:0:02CA
name: chain_to_saved_handler
description: When two status values are both at their idle value and a tick counter exceeds a limit, it calls a routine. It then passes control to a saved handler pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:bootblock:0:0300
name: match_keyboard_handshake_sequence
description: Reads keyboard serial bytes one at a time, waiting for each to arrive, and compares it with an expected bit-rotated value until a terminator byte is reached. It then returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a3]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a3].adf:bootblock:0:036A
name: enable_dma_channels
description: Writes a DMA control word with the set bit fifteen so that the DMA channels are enabled, then returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0786
name: call_with_pointer_argument
description: Passes its pointer argument to another routine and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0798
name: init_disk_port_for_drive
description: Initializes the disk port for a drive: it records the unit and clears the state fields, creates a port for the trackdisk device, and reports a fatal error when the port or drive cannot be used.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:08A4
name: store_pair_and_clear_field
description: Stores its two arguments into fields of the program's state record and clears a third field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:08BC
name: store_value_and_clear_flag
description: Stores its argument in a field of the program's state record and clears a second field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:08CE
name: copy_bytes_into_sector_buffer
description: Copies a byte stream into a 512-byte sector buffer, flushing each full sector and handling a partial sector at the start and end. It updates the running position counters.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:09BA
name: write_sectors_from_buffer
description: Writes a sequence of 512-byte sectors starting at a computed block index, advancing the position counter after each write.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:09E0
name: write_sector_run
description: Writes consecutive 512-byte sectors from a list of buffer pointers, advancing the position counter and block count after each write while bytes remain.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0A14
name: close_open_handles
description: Closes the program's open file handle when one is held; otherwise it closes the secondary handle and releases it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0A50
name: seek_to_disk_sector
description: Computes the next disk sector from the current position, skipping two sectors past a fixed boundary, and seeks to it when it differs from the last one. In file mode it seeks to the position and reads a full 512-byte sector instead.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0AEC
name: build_sector_read_request
description: Fills in a disk I/O request with a read command code, a 512-byte length, a buffer address and a byte offset from the sector number, then submits it to the device.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0B16
name: build_sector_write_request
description: Fills in a disk I/O request with the write command code, the same 512-byte length, buffer and byte offset from the sector number, then submits it to the device.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0B40
name: prompt_insert_data_disk
description: Prompts the user to insert the Battle Chess data disk and repeats the prompt until the disk is present, then returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0B9C
name: verify_battle_chess_disk_title
description: Saves the disk request state, reads a 4096-byte block, compares it with the title text and then restores the saved state. It returns one when the title matches.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0C68
name: submit_disk_control_command
description: Sets a different command code in the disk request and submits it to the device.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0C80
name: submit_idle_disk_request
description: When no request is pending, sets command code nine with a zero length in the disk request and submits it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0CA4
name: return_disk_status_field
description: Marks the disk status as unset with minus one and returns the stored disk value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0CB8
name: build_disk_header_block
description: Clears a 132-byte area, copies the given name into the area after it, sets two bytes in the header, and passes the 32-byte block to another routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0CFE
name: fill_bytes_with_value
description: Fills a memory block with a given byte value, counting down through a 32-bit length.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0D8C
name: empty_return_stub
description: Empty library routine that returns straight away without any other action.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0D94
name: setup_standard_io_handles
description: Allocates a work block and sets up the process's standard input and output and current directory through library calls. It stores the handles it obtains for later use.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:0ED0
name: split_command_line_arguments
description: Splits a command-line string into words, honouring quoted text, copying each word into a fresh buffer and building a null-terminated array of pointers to them.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:1094
name: copy_limited_string_with_pad
description: Copies a source string into a fixed-size destination for at most a given count of bytes, stopping at the terminator, then fills the rest of the destination with zero bytes. It returns the destination pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:10B6
name: copy_memory_block_overlap_safe
description: Copies a block of memory of a given size, copying backwards when the destination overlaps the source's tail so the bytes are not corrupted. It does nothing when source and destination are the same.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:10F0
name: append_string_limited_length
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, copying at most 32766 characters and terminating the result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:10F6
name: insert_string_at_end
description: Finds the terminator of the destination string and copies up to a given count of characters from the source onto that point. It adds a terminator when the source is not used up, and returns the destination pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:111A
name: compare_two_byte_strings
description: Compares two byte strings up to a fixed length limit. It returns minus one if the first is smaller at the first difference, one if larger, and zero when they match.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:114A
name: copy_string_to_buffer
description: Copies a source string to a destination buffer including its terminator and returns the destination pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:115A
name: open_window_and_icon_library
description: Opens the WINDOW device and the icon library, obtaining the icon structure from the icon library and storing it with the window data. It releases the temporary handle when done.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:ChessToDH0:0:120C
name: store_pointer_call_and_terminate
description: Stores its first argument in a global slot, calls another routine with the second argument and a stack address, then writes a zero byte through the stored pointer and returns the call's result.
